liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **To Lay Me Down** (2 reviews): Sunset happened while Jerry sang it, which the listener remembers as a perfect Dead moment; Listener heard it, with Rider, Long Way to Go Home, The Last Time and China Doll, as Jerry's farewell message [15][22]
- **Casey Jones** (2 reviews): Called totally slamming; the reviewer was nearly alone losing it on the lawn, calling it a classic encore; Billy played train horns while bright white lights shone behind him like a northbound locomotive headlight [25][26]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry wasn't stepping up on it, with weak playing in the first set [25]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China>Rider pairing is called nice [21]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry's best solo in any version of this song [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **To Lay Me Down**: back after 129 archived shows (562 days) [27]
- **Electronic Percussion**: back after 113 archived shows (458 days); rare: 12 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-28.aud.andrewf.90152.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min [1]. Said about its sound: A subsecond glitch at 1:07 of China Cat was repaired with Soundforge [1]
- **gd1992-06-28.140204.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1992-06-28.dsbd.miller.32550.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [4]
- **gd1992-06-28.mtx.hansokolow.97810.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 151 min [6]
- **gd92-06-28.sbd.braverman.8601.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 4.17/5 by 30 [10]. Said about its sound: Audible hiss suggests two or three cassette generations; judged a disappointing, not top-notch transfer [24]

## Around the show

- Fireworks went off after Casey Jones; the first set was nearly flawless and suited a summer afternoon [15]
- Reviewer felt Jerry looked drained, a month before his collapse; the day and venue were otherwise fine [18]
- Listener on the hill's upper slope felt Jerry's songs signaled a final tour; his collapse came two months later, with no fall tour [22]
- Reviewer was backstage and thought Casey Jones had been absent from setlists for a long time [23]
- Reviewer ranks the first set among the year's best, perhaps the best of the final five years [15]
- Attendee of every 1992 show calls this the year's best, with a setlist well above that year's average [20]
- Reviewer corrects that it was not the first time Casey Jones was played, but the second [26]
- This copy lacks eight minutes of tuning that appear in shnid 28395 [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-28.aud.andrewf.90152.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > unknown mic power and lead dat deck > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 > Sony DDS-Dat tape. Mics on seven foot stand, set up dead center,… [1]. Also: Audience recording with cable-caused signal losses, patched from another source (ShnID-550) in Franklin's Tower and Wang Dang Doodle [1]
- **gd1992-06-28.140204.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make this soundboard-based show complete [3]
- **gd1992-06-28.dsbd.miller.32550.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: Made from audio discs supplied by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller, with digital noise in Wang Dang Doodle [4]
- **gd1992-06-28.mtx.hansokolow.97810.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=32550 and DAUD: shnid=90152 by hansokolow using ProTools [6]. Also: Matrix by hansokolow in ProTools, blending the soundboard CD source with an audience recording; Audience mics: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 in ORTF on a seven-foot stand, dead center behind the last seats, recorded to DAT [6]
- **gd92-06-28.sbd.braverman.8601.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Cassette> DAT> CD [10]
